_README: Quarterly goals for Silver & Salt Capital, in the form the daily agent reads.
The granola-pull-dashboard-deploy task reads this file every morning and writes
exactly 2 goal-aligned task suggestions into granola-inbox.js tagged source
'suggestion'. The dashboard shows those in their own block above Staging.
This file mirrors goals.js. Tori edits goals in the dashboard UI; those edits
live in browser storage, so this file must be updated deliberately or the agent
will work from stale goals. The dashboard flags that state rather than hiding it.
